Challenges
• Macroeconomic & finance market
challenges
• Low/negative interest rates (impact
investment return particularly life
insurers with guaranteed products.
• Inflation rising (impact claims cost
and mismatches asset and liabilities)
• Volatility & uncertainty (Covid,
geopolitical tensions, energy crisis)
• Regulatory and Capital requirements
• Technology and Digital Transformation
• Climate Change and Emerging Risks:
Catastrophe losses (wildfires, floods,
hurricanes), new risks (cyber,
pandemic…)
